messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — UK Insureco sent a follow-up asking for 'embeddings stored in-region only' and a hard TTL for any PII-derived vectors. They said renewal depends on confirmation by EOD. :exclamation:
Tom (Solutions Eng): Understood. Do they require Dedicated/Private or will region pinning with strict KMS suffice?
Aisha (CS): Their note: no cross-border copies, ability to rotate keys and evidence deletion, and short retention windows. They mentioned Dedicated as a fallback.
Sam (Security): We can offer Hosted EU with account-scoped KMS and no cross-region replication, but must confirm backups & async snapshots are not replicated. Also need to supply redacted proof of key rotations/deletions.
Jules (Legal): I'll prepare a DPA addendum with three options: Hosted EU + contractual residency; Dedicated with BYOK; Private. Also add deletion attestation language.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Technical summary for CS to relay:
- Hosted EU: embeddings kept in eu-west-2, account-scoped KMS keys, index TTL configurable via API (example: ttl_seconds=604800 for 7 days). Backups can be disabled per-tenant; snapshots kept in-region only.
- Dedicated: isolated object store, optional BYOK, no shared backups.
- Private: deployable package, air-gap option.
Aisha (CS): Can you add the exact API call for TTL change?
Tom (Solutions Eng): Sure — example: POST /v1/embeddings/indices/my-index/retention with JSON payload { 'ttl_seconds': 604800 }. Admin API supports key rotation events which we can include in audit export.
Sam (Security): Two preconditions before confirming Hosted: 1) Ops to verify backups disabled for tenant, ticket needed; 2) Provide redacted rotation/deletion logs for proof.
Aisha (CS): Action plan: open ops ticket for backup verification by 14:00, Sam to attach redacted logs by 16:00, Jules to produce addendum draft by COB. If we miss EOD customer may ask for Dedicated pricing which affects renewal.
OnboardBot: Ticket created — OPS-4922 'Verify eu-west-2 tenant backup/replication settings for UK Insureco'.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Suggest pseudonymization (salt + hash before embedding) as low-friction mitigation. Note: may slightly affect retrieval accuracy.
Aisha (CS): Include pseudonymization as recommended option and call out accuracy tradeoff.
Sam (Security): I'll prepare a short checklist for the customer: 1) pick deployment option, 2) sign addendum, 3) confirm TTL and pseudonymization, 4) schedule PS for Dedicated/Private if selected.
Aisha (CS): I'll stitch checklist + API snippets into an email to the customer and cc legal/security. Will update thread once ops/Legal deliverables are in.
Jules (Legal): Draft uploaded to Drive: https://drive.reddemo/legal/insureco-addendum — comments welcome.
Sam (Security): Uploaded redacted rotation log to OPS-4922.
Aisha (CS): Ops confirmed backups disabled for tenant at 13:42 UTC. Sending Hosted EU proposal now.
Aisha (CS): Customer replied: 'Hosted EU with pseudonymization and 7-day TTL acceptable, please provide deletion evidence within 30 days.'
Jules (Legal): I'll add a deletion attestation clause with 30-day window and a certified deletion report option.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team — looks like likely renewal. Moving to customer thread and will close internal loop once addendum is signed. :tada:
